items.title: Are there other Burmese spelling or repetition issues in protected-area data?
assumptions: The already-known တိရိစ္ဆာန် issue was explicitly excluded from the result.
Confirmed findings are limited to high-confidence spelling, code-point, and repeated-text issues.
Ambiguous proper names, translations, and duplicate species labels are reported separately for editorial review.

source.label: Wildlife protected-area source data
filters: Excluded text: တိရိစ္ဆာန်
caveats: Automated patterns were manually reviewed, but the scan cannot prove that every free-text Burmese sentence is linguistically perfect.
The non-standard ဥ်/ဉ် group is counted separately from high-confidence visible typos.

evidenceFlow.title: Spelling and code-point checks
evidenceFlow.detail: The review checked curated high-confidence Burmese spellings, look-alike Myanmar digit and letter code points, and internal spelling consistency.

evidenceFlow.title: Repetition checks
evidenceFlow.detail: The review checked repeated characters, repeated words, repeated list values, and repeated sentences.

sourceRoles.label: data/protected_areas.json
sourceRoles.role: Complete protected-area source records and Burmese-language fields used for the follow-up audit.
